newsitem.title: USA: Perry to visit Bosnia, Gulf, Japan.
newsitem.headline: Perry to visit Bosnia, Gulf, Japan.

text.p: Defence Secretary William Perry will visit U.S. troops in Bosnia next week on a globe-circling trip that will also take him to the Gulf and and Japan, the Pentagon said on Friday.

Perry will visit Naples, Italy, next Wednesday and will spend Thursday -- the U.S. Thanksgiving Day holiday -- with U.S. troops in Tuzla in Bosnia. He will then go to Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar in the Gulf and to Japan before returning to Washington on Dec. 4.

Perry is expected to meet with Russian military officials in Bosnia on future participation by U.S. and Russian military forces in a follow-on peacekeeping force in Bosnia next year. Both countries currently have troops serving in a NATO-led peace implementation force there.

In Saudi Arabia, he will hold talks with top Saudi officials on security in the region and is expected to visit an air base in the desert not far from Riyadh. Most of the U.S. military personnel serving in the kingdom were moved to the base recently.
The move was made following a bombing in Saudi Arabia last year and another in June of this year that took the lives of 24 U.S. troops.
Perry said recently that the United States had not determined a culprit, but published reports have said the Saudis have arrested about 40 persons in connection with the investigation.
